courses.description: Ideas and methods of group theory and their applications. Groups, subgroups, and cosets; homomorphisms, isomorphisms, and associated theorems. courses.title: Introduction to Dynamical Systems
courses.description: Ideas, methods and applications of bifurcation theory and dynamical systems: differential and difference equations, local bifurcations, perturbation methods, chaos. Recommended pre-requisites: one of MATH 215, MATH 255, MATH 256 and one of MATH 256, MATH 257, MATH 316. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

courses.title: Advanced Dynamical Systems
courses.description: Topics from: hyperbolic invariant sets and symbolic dynamics, global bifurcations, local bifurcations for partial differential equations, multiple bifurcations, bifurcations and symmetry, applications. Prerequisite: MATH 552. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

prereq.text: MATH 552

courses.title: Symmetries and Differential Equations
courses.description: Dimensional analysis, modelling, and invariance. Lie groups of transformations, infinitesimal transformations. Applications to ordinary and partial differential equations. No knowledge of group theory will be assumed. Recommended pre-requisite: elementary courses in differential equations and linear algebra. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

courses.title: Linear and Nonlinear Waves
courses.description: Classical and recent results in linear and nonlinear waves. Geometrical acoustics and kinematic waves; large amplitude waves in weakly stratified media; small amplitude waves in strongly stratified media. Dispersive waves; group velocity; applications. Recommended pre-requisites: MATH 400 and some knowledge of either fluid mechanics or elasticity. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

courses.title: Mathematical Biology
courses.description: Mathematical methods in modelling biological processes, at levels from cell biochemistry to community ecology. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

courses.title: Mathematics of Infectious Diseases and Immunology
courses.description: Mathematical models for disease spread in populations. Within-host infectious disease dynamics. Models of the immune system and immune cells. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

courses.title: Mathematical Electrophysiology
courses.description: Formulation and analysis of models of excitable media. FitzHugh-Nagumo model, ionic models of membrane excitability (e.g., Hodgkin-Huxley), calcium excitability, bursting phenomena. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

courses.title: Modelling of Cell-Scale Biology
courses.description: Concepts and techniques for modelling cellular and subcellular dynamics in biological systems. Topics may include complex biochemical systems, biopolymers in cell motility and division, continuum mechanics, and membrane dynamics. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

courses.title: Evolutionary Dynamics
courses.description: Mathematical models of evolution and evolutionary game theory. Stochastic dynamics in finite populations, dynamics in spatially structured populations, and adaptive dynamics. Applications include the origin of species and the problem of cooperation. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.
